blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo.

In "Password Please", you learn the everyday English you need when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting. Today you learn five useful words and practise them in short, natural sentences.

Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: What does IT support at Czarnikow?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: When do you need this English?
options: When you talk to the help desk or join a meeting
items.why: "when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting."

items.q: "Go slowly — one step at a time" suggests that the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: o tom "go slowly" e "you can do it" passa calma e confiança.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: IT only helps the big offices
learning English is too hard for you
you can learn this English step by step
items.why: Inferência: "one step at a time. You can do it!" — a mensagem é que dá para aprender aos poucos.

blocks.instruction: Ouça a colaboradora ligar para o help desk. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi James, this is Sophie. Can you help me, please? I have a problem this morning.

I want to log in, but my password does not work. I type it again and again, but the computer says "wrong password". I am a little worried. I have a meeting at ten o'clock and I need my email.

My username is fine. It is sophie dot green. Only the password is the problem. Can you reset it for me, please? That is very kind.

Okay, I have a new password now. Thank you so much, James. You are always so helpful. I can log in and open my email. Now I am ready for my meeting. Have a good day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why does Sophie call James?
items.why: "my password does not work."

items.q: What is fine — not the problem?
items.why: "My username is fine… Only the password is the problem."

items.q: What does Sophie ask James to do?
items.why: "Can you reset it for me, please?"

items.q: Why is Sophie a little worried?
options: She has a meeting at ten and needs her email
items.why: Inferência: ela precisa do email antes da reunião das dez, por isso fica preocupada.

items.q: How does Sophie feel at the end of the call?
items.why: Inferência: ela agradece, consegue logar e diz que está pronta para a reunião.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My password is secret. I never share it." A password is…
options: a secret word to enter a system
items.why: Password = senha: a palavra secreta para entrar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please type your ___ and then your password to enter."
items.why: Username = nome de usuário, que vem antes da senha.

items.q: "I click the button to login every morning." To login means to…
items.why: Login = entrar / acessar o sistema.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I forgot my password, so IT must ___ it for me."
items.why: Reset = redefinir: criar uma nova senha.

items.q: "Can you help me, please?" To help means to…
items.why: Help = ajudar / dar suporte.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia com o help desk. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you log in now?" To log in means to…
items.why: Log in = entrar na sua conta.

items.q: "Please log out before you go home." To log out means to…
items.why: Log out = sair da conta.

items.q: "IT will set up your new computer today." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar / configurar para usar.

items.q: "If it is slow, please restart the computer." To restart means to…
options: turn it off and on again
items.why: Restart = reiniciar: desligar e ligar de novo.

items.q: "Can you hold on a moment, please?" To hold on means to…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento.
